parsed.post: Discarding ASPECT_RATIO=64 experiment (1.0099 vs 1.0088). It seems the higher ASPECT_RATIO might be slightly over-parameterizing or causing instability in the 5-minute window. Reverting to DEPTH=6, LR=0.05, WARMUP=0.1, AR=32 (implied by baseline/previous best). Next: Testing a slightly higher MATRIX_LR with WARMUP=0.1 to see if we can find a better peak.
parsed.description: Revert ASPECT_RATIO to 32 and slightly increase MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.07 to find a better convergence point.
